west.label: Monster last seen two columns west and one row south
west.explanation: A level-20 Warrior with a Lantern stands in a dark room. A cave bear was last seen two columns west and one row south of it, in the lantern light, and has since walked away. The Borg's own light map is updated by the production routine and then the production follow-up for the vanished monster runs. Original: the grid is not marked as lit, so the Borg does not expect to see the bear there and keeps it as a ghost in its monster list. Corrected: the grid is lit, the follow-up runs and the ghost is forgotten.
